instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL text interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
Site must be 100% in French language as specified.
Do NOT build an online shopping cart or payment system; order calls must trigger standard tel: link to 0557939146.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance reveals, food card hovers, tab switches, and mobile menu transitions.
Ensure dark theme elegance with high gold contrast readability.
Include clear call buttons for phone ordering in Header, Hero, Menu, and Sticky Mobile Bar.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, phone links, tabs, cards) MUST contain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure text over dark backgrounds maintains WCAG AA standard or APCA standards. Gold text on black should be bold or high contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_cart_flow: Phone orders only. Clicking order triggers prompt modal or direct tel:0557939146 action.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: Fully responsive from mobile (320px) to desktop extra-wide (1920px).
